## ⚠️ Pull Requests Not Accepted

GT AI OS Community is a **read-only distribution** of GT AI OS.

**We do not accept pull requests.** This PR will be closed without review.

---

### How to Contribute

**This repository is Gen 2.** It is no longer actively supported except for security patches. Active development is in [GT AI OS Gen 3](https://github.com/GT-Edge-AI/GT-AI-OS).

- **New deployments, bugs, and features:** [GT AI OS Gen 3](https://github.com/GT-Edge-AI/GT-AI-OS)
- **Security vulnerabilities in Gen 2:** [Open an issue](https://github.com/GT-Edge-AI-Internal/gt-ai-os-community/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
- **Questions:** [Start a discussion](https://github.com/GT-Edge-AI-Internal/gt-ai-os-community/discussions)

Thank you for your interest in GT AI OS!
